create_unity2_alignment_model: create a UnitY2 alignment model from a config with optional device and dtype
build_alignment_frontend: build a UnitY2 alignment frontend with text and unit embeddings and tokenizers
build_alignment_encoder: build a UnitY2 alignment encoder with configurable layers, dropout, temperature, and reduction factor
build_model: build a complete UnitY2 alignment model from a builder with frontend and encoder
register_aligner_architecture: register a nar_t2u aligner architecture with predefined encoder and frontend configuration
